intake.budget: Calculate your mortgage budget including buyer's costs, not before them.
intake.profile: Record your housing wishes and priorities (location, type, budget, must-haves).
intake.nhg: Check whether the National Mortgage Guarantee (NHG) applies to you and is a sensible choice.

research.analysis: Read the property check and its points of attention per domain, not just the final grade.
research.compare: Compare candidate properties side by side on price, m², energy and VvE signals.
research.listing: Link the Funda listing so asking price, characteristics and VvE details are included.
research.ai: Request the AI research for extra context (permits, municipal plans, contradictions).

viewing.checklist: Walk through the viewing checklist, including the points of attention from the property check.
viewing.questions: Ask the questions raised by the AI analysis or document check.
viewing.debrief: Record immediately afterwards: continue, doubt, or drop — and why.

offer.strategy: Set your offer with the bid strategy: cautious, balanced or strong, based on the risks.
offer.conditions: Keep financing and inspection resolutive conditions in place, especially as a first-time buyer or with open points of attention.
offer.valuation: Remember: no valuation means no confirmed market value. Never bid blindly above the asking price.

negotiation.counter: On a counteroffer: adjust only the amount or the conditions, never both at once without reason.
negotiation.escalation: Under competition, consider a bidding escalation clause instead of blindly bidding higher.
negotiation.walkaway: Know your maximum price upfront and be prepared to walk away once it is exceeded.

contract.review: Have the deed of purchase checked before signing; compare the amount with your offer.
contract.deadlines: Put the cooling-off period and your resolutive-condition deadlines in your calendar right away.
contract.clauses: Ask for an explanation of unusual clauses (age clause, asbestos clause, leasehold).

finance_inspection.mortgage: Finalise the mortgage application well before the financing deadline.
finance_inspection.inspection: Schedule the structural inspection and address the findings before the inspection deadline.
finance_inspection.documents: Request missing documents (VvE, MJOP, building drawings, energy) and let them inform your decision.

transfer.final-inspection: Do the final inspection just before the transfer and record handover points in writing.
transfer.notary: Check the settlement statement and the draft deed at the civil-law notary before signing.
transfer.keys: Arrange deposit/bank guarantee, insurance and the key handover.

unavailable.label: No data
unavailable.explainer: There is no reliable open-data source available for this topic right now.

signalInterpretation.domainEmpty: No reliable data for this topic.

air.explainer: {value} µg/m³ {pollutant} is a neighbourhood average from RIVM data — lower is healthier, but ventilation and street-level traffic count too.

crime.explainer: {value} registered offences per 1,000 residents — national average around {average}. Police figures only, no prediction for your home.

ses.explainer: SES-WOA {value} — the Netherlands ≈ 0. This is neighbourhood context on wealth, education and work, not a judgement of the home or your neighbours.

near.label: Close by
near.explainer: Within walking or cycling distance — usually easy to reach in daily life.

reachable.label: Reasonably reachable
reachable.explainer: Within about a kilometre — usually still manageable by bike or a short drive.

farther.label: Further away
farther.explainer: More than a kilometre — plan consciously how you get there day to day.

far.label: Far
far.explainer: Relatively far for daily use — check whether that fits your life.

attention.summary: {count} point{plural} need extra attention alongside the area score {score} / 10.

mixed.headline: Mixed picture — check the details
mixed.summary: Area score {score} / 10 with both strengths and points of attention. {coverage}.

taxateur.whatTheyDo: Determines the market value for your mortgage. The bank lends based on the lower of purchase price and appraised value.
howToChoose: Choose your own, even when the bank or real estate agent suggests one — you are not obliged to use theirs.
Must be listed in the NRVT register (required for NHG and most mortgage lenders).
Ask for a fixed price upfront and a delivery time; do not call the selling agent's appraiser.

keurder.whatTheyDo: Assesses the technical condition (roof, foundation, moisture, installations) before you let the inspection condition lapse.
howToChoose: Choose an inspector independent of the selling agent — no shared referral fee or fixed referral arrangement.
Ask whether the report follows a scoring system such as NEN 2767 or another traceable standard.
Join the inspection yourself; a good inspector explains on the spot what he sees.
Compare quotes from at least two independent inspectors; there is no statutory public register.

notaris.whatTheyDo: Drafts the transfer deed and the mortgage deed and handles the transfer. The buyer chooses the notary, not the seller.
howToChoose: Request a fixed-price quote (all-in rate) from at least two offices before choosing.
Must be registered with the KNB (Royal Professional Organisation of Civil-law Notaries).
Ask for the draft deed well before the signing date so you have time to ask questions.

ses.label: SES-WOA
ses.hint: Wealth, education and work in the neighbourhood
ses.caveat: Neighbourhood average; not a judgement of households or the home.

education.label: Education level
education.caveat: No school quality or Cito scores; only the education mix in the neighbourhood.

schools.label: Schools nearby
schools.caveat: Distance, not inspection results. Quality: scholenopdekaart.nl.

crime.label: Offences
crime.caveat: Registration figures; not every incident is reported.

woz.label: Avg. WOZ value
woz.caveat: Neighbourhood WOZ average, not an asking price or €/m² from listings.
